cell_mapping.archer_right_left: Two 2x2 sources: rows 0/1 map right/left; first source columns 0/1 map output phases 0/1, second source columns 0/1 map output phases 2/3
cell_mapping.witch: Front: original 4x4 row0. Rear and right: separate 4x1 replacement sources. Left: original side 4x2 row1. Row-only lossless replacements preserve visible RGB and alpha in all other directions. Final LEFT/RIGHT hat-only raster overlay uses one stable template per direction from the 4x2 side-hat source (RIGHT top, LEFT bottom), with recorded crop/placement in reports/class-motion/witch-hat-review/patch-config.json. Original body and other-direction pixels are retained.

processing: Crop to the connected character bounds to exclude detached neighboring-cell hat/outline fragments.
Preserve authored pixels and equipment handedness; no frame mirroring or limb painting.
Align the head center and planted-foot baseline within padded transparent cells.
validation: reports/class-motion/{class}-final/motion-report.json records the final runtime SHA256, browser immutable URL, actual movement samples and manual review.
